user.title: Light routines
user.description: Create daily sunrise and manual bedtime routines. Stopping a routine freezes its current brightness; starting the other replaces it. The daily schedule can be disabled independently.

error.required_values: Enter a name and select at least one light.
error.not_dimmable: Every selected light must expose brightness control.
error.lights_in_use: A selected light already belongs to another Light Routines entry.
error.routine_active: Stop the active routine before changing its settings.
